question: Will Destatis's preliminary German CPI (VPI) annual rate for Nov 2026, published 2026-11-30, be 2.8% or higher?
note:
An article published on November 25, 2026, by Wirtschaftsjournal states that the preliminary German inflation rate for October 2026 was 2.8%. The text explicitly notes: 'So hoch liegt die Rate in Deutschland nach der vorläufigen Schätzung für Oktober 2026' (The rate in Germany is this high according to the preliminary estimate for October 2026).

Source: https://wirtschaftsjournal.com/nominalzins-realzins/ (published 2026-11-25).
